name: Law2_ScGeom_PotentialLubricationPhys
description: Material law for lubrication + potential between two spheres. The potential model include contact. This material law will solve the system with lubrication and the provided potential.

attributes.name: MaxIter
attributes.description: Maximum iterations for numerical resolution (Dichotomy and Newton-Rafson)

attributes.name: SolutionTol
attributes.description: Tolerance for numerical resolution (Dichotomy and Newton-Rafson)

attributes.name: maxSubSteps
attributes.description: max recursion depth of adaptative timestepping in the theta-method, the minimal time interval is thus

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.description: Change normal component resolution method, 0: Iterative exact resolution with substepping (theta method, linear contact), 1: Newton-Rafson dimensionless resolution (theta method, linear contact), 2: (default) Dichotomy dimensionless resolution (theta method, linear contact), 3: Exact dimensionless solution with contact prediction (theta method, linear contact). Method 3 is better if the volumic fraction is not too high. Use 2 otherwise.

attributes.name: theta
attributes.description: parameter of the 'theta'-method, 1: backward Euler, 0.5: trapezoidal rule, 0: not used,  0.55: suggested optimum)

methods.name: getStressForEachBody
methods.description: Get stresses tensors for each bodies: normal contact stress, shear contact stress, normal lubrication stress, shear lubrication stress, stress from additionnal potential forces.

methods.name: getTotalStresses
methods.description: Get total stresses tensors: normal contact stress, shear contact stress, normal lubrication stress, shear lubrication stress, stress from additionnal potential forces.
